title:
3D cameras for bins,
pallets and body panels
lede: A bin, a pallet or a body panel from one stationary capture: guidance, picking, inspection.
stat1_desc_d: kg housing for all four models.
body: One capture locates a parcel, a casting or a spindle and gives TridiVision the data to plan the robot path; the same cameras inspect sleepers, body panels and security trays.
th_fov: Field of view at optimum WD (mm)
footnote: <sup>1</sup> Regional 2σ on a ceramic reference plate, method on page 22. Full specification on pages 18 to 20.
app1: Mixed parcels in a bin — random bin picking — point cloud
app2: Twin-block railway sleepers — block geometry — height map
app3: Stamped body panel — hole position and surface — height map
app4: Crushed aggregate — particle size — height map
app5: Yarn spindles in bulk — random picking — camera image
app6: Stamped body panels — two panels in one capture — height map
